প্রদত্ত সমীকরণ: y=2xx+1y = \dfrac{2x}{x + 1}y=x+12x​
নির্ণেয়: dydx\dfrac{dy}{dx}dxdy​
📘 English Note — Linear Rational Formulation
The problem presents a rational polynomial quotient with a linear monomial numerator and affine denominator: y=u(x)v(x),where u(x)=2x,  v(x)=x+1y = \frac{u(x)}{v(x)}, \quad \text{where } u(x) = 2x, \; v(x) = x + 1y=v(x)u(x)​,where u(x)=2x,v(x)=x+1 Applying the fundamental Quotient Rule: ddx(uv)=vdudx−udvdxv2,with ddx(2x)=2,  ddx(x+1)=1\frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac{u}{v}\right) = \frac{v \frac{du}{dx} - u \frac{dv}{dx}}{v^2}, \quad \text{with } \frac{d}{dx}(2x) = 2, \; \frac{d}{dx}(x + 1) = 1dxd​(vu​)=v2vdxdu​−udxdv​​,with dxd​(2x)=2,dxd​(x+1)=1
১. গাণিতিক কাঠামো ও প্রয়োজনীয় সূত্রসমূহ

লব (uuu) 2x2x2x ddx(2x)=2\dfrac{d}{dx}(2x) = 2dxd​(2x)=2
হর (vvv) x+1x + 1x+1 ddx(x+1)=1\dfrac{d}{dx}(x + 1) = 1dxd​(x+1)=1
হরের বর্গ (v2v^2v2) (x+1)2(x + 1)^2(x+1)2 (x+1)2(x + 1)^2(x+1)2 (উৎপাদক আকারেই রাখা সমীচীন)
⚠️ English Note — Critical AMIE Exam Traps & Pitfalls
1. Linear Subtraction Simplification: Expand carefully: 2(x+1)−2x=2x+2−2x=+22(x + 1) - 2x = \mathbf{2x + 2 - 2x = +2}2(x+1)−2x=2x+2−2x=+2 Avoid dropping the constant term 222 to mistakenly write 000 or 2x2x2x.
2. Factored Form: Do not expand (x+1)2(x+1)^2(x+1)2 into x2+2x+1x^2+2x+1x2+2x+1. Leaving it in factored form is canonical in AMIE engineering exams.

dydx=ddx(2xx+1)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac{2x}{x + 1}\right)dxdy​=dxd​(x+12x​)
ধাপ ২:
ভাগফলের সূত্র (Quotient Rule) অনুসারে সাজানো:
dydx=(x+1)ddx(2x)−(2x)ddx(x+1)(x+1)2\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{(x + 1)\frac{d}{dx}(2x) - (2x)\frac{d}{dx}(x + 1)}{(x + 1)^2}dxdy​=(x+1)2(x+1)dxd​(2x)−(2x)dxd​(x+1)​
ধাপ ৩:
প্রমিত অন্তরজের মান ddx(2x)=2\frac{d}{dx}(2x)=2dxd​(2x)=2 এবং ddx(x+1)=1\frac{d}{dx}(x+1)=1dxd​(x+1)=1 বসিয়ে:
dydx=(x+1)⋅2−(2x)⋅1(x+1)2\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{(x + 1)\cdot 2 - (2x)\cdot 1}{(x + 1)^2}dxdy​=(x+1)2(x+1)⋅2−(2x)⋅1​

ধাপ ৪:
লবের বন্ধনী বিস্তার ও পদসমূহ সরলীকরণ:
dydx=2x+2−2x(x+1)2=2(x+1)2\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{2x + 2 - 2x}{(x + 1)^2} = \frac{2}{(x + 1)^2}dxdy​=(x+1)22x+2−2x​=(x+1)22​
চূড়ান্ত উত্তর (Final Standard Answer)
dydx=2(x+1)2\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{2}{(x + 1)^2}dxdy​=(x+1)22​
🔬 English Note — Domain, Monotonicity & Asymptotes
  • Domain of Function & Derivative: Non-zero denominator requires x+1≠0  ⟹  x≠−1x + 1 \neq 0 \implies x \neq -1x+1=0⟹x=−1. Thus, Dom(y)=Dom(dydx)=R∖{−1}\text{Dom}(y) = \text{Dom}\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right) = \mathbb{R} \setminus \{-1\}Dom(y)=Dom(dxdy​)=R∖{−1}.
  • Strict Increasing Monotonicity: For all x≠−1x \neq -1x=−1, (x+1)2>0(x+1)^2 > 0(x+1)2>0, hence dydx=2(x+1)2>0\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{2}{(x+1)^2} > 0dxdy​=(x+1)22​>0. The function is strictly increasing on its domain.
  • Asymptotes: Vertical asymptote at x=−1x = -1x=−1; Horizontal asymptote at y=lim⁡x→±∞2xx+1=2y = \lim_{x\to\pm\infty}\frac{2x}{x+1} = 2y=limx→±∞​x+12x​=2.
💡 English Note — Determinant & Synthetic Shift Double Check
  1. Determinant Method: y=2x+01x+1  ⟹  ad−bc=(2)(1)−(0)(1)=2  ⟹  dydx=2(x+1)2y = \frac{2x+0}{1x+1} \implies ad-bc = (2)(1)-(0)(1) = 2 \implies \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{2}{(x+1)^2}y=1x+12x+0​⟹ad−bc=(2)(1)−(0)(1)=2⟹dxdy​=(x+1)22​
  2. Synthetic Shift: y=2(x+1)−2x+1=2−2(x+1)−1  ⟹  dydx=0−2(−1)(x+1)−2=2(x+1)2y = \frac{2(x+1)-2}{x+1} = 2 - 2(x+1)^{-1} \implies \frac{dy}{dx} = 0 - 2(-1)(x+1)^{-2} = \frac{2}{(x+1)^2}y=x+12(x+1)−2​=2−2(x+1)−1⟹dxdy​=0−2(−1)(x+1)−2=(x+1)22​
